name: School of Chiron · Terra
notes: A style of Pelion (School of Chiron · Marble): everything is Pelion's but the floor, the one Pelion had before its white pebbles.

art room-floor: a quiet pebble mosaic in sand (1, lit 3, gaps 2) with a terracotta pebble and slate in a motif, its motifs a small terracotta flower and a pair of slate pebbles; the sanctum's rosette mosaic on a terracotta field (N), blue corner squares. The sheet is the one Pelion shipped at 00df42a; its generator is generators/pelion/room-floor.mjs at that commit.
px 1 2 3: the sand pebbles' colours of that floor (Pelion retuned them to bluish whites); no other drawn Pelion family uses them.
